name: Monster Sweethearts
source:
Monster Sweethearts is a free lesbian Monster dating sim set in the rural town of Black Wood. You're stuck planning the Monster Sweetheart dance after being exposed to the existence of monsters. But you don't have a date to the dance! Through five different possible routes you might end up with a very special lady depending on your choices throughout the game.

[Edited from [url=https://llonelly.itch.io/monster-sweethearts]itch.io[/url]]
